name: Clay Style
description: Soft inflated forms, pastel color, and a pressed-clay shadow.
bestFor: Friendly tools and onboarding that should feel squishy and calm.
promptFragment: Visual style: Clay Style. Build claymorphism: puffy rounded forms, pastel surfaces, a soft outer shadow, and an inset highlight so controls look pressed from clay. Use a friendly sans and large radii. Avoid hard comic offsets, hairline rules, neon, and sharp corners. Keep text readable: meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast (4.5:1) against the surface the text actually sits on. https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/contrast-minimum.html
